titleEnglish: Ya Muhammad Noor E Mujassam — Traditional

verses.ar: Ya Muhammad Noor-e-mujassam Ya Habibi Ya Maulai
verses.en: O Muhammad, embodied light — O my Beloved, O my Master
The perfect image of love, the radiance of divine beauty

verses.ar:
Tera Wasf Bayaan Ho Kis Se Teri Kon Karega Barayei
Iss Gard-e-safar Mein Gum Hai Jibreel-e-ameen Ki Rasayei
verses.en:
Who can describe your qualities — who can sing your praises?
Even the reach of Jibreel the Trustworthy is lost in the dust of your journey

verses.ar:
Teri Ek Nazar Ke Taalib, Tere Ek Sukhan Par Qurabaan
Ye Sab Tere Divaane, Ye Sab Tere Shayadai
verses.en:
They long for just one glance from you, they sacrifice themselves for just one word
All of these are your devotees, all of these are your lovers

verses.ar:
Ye Rung-e-bahar-e-gulshan Ye Gul Aur Gul Ka Joban
Tere Noor-e-qadam Ka Dhowan Uss Dhowan Ki Ra'nayei
verses.en:
The colours of the garden in spring, the flower and its beauty
Are but the smoke of the light of your footstep — and what beauty that smoke holds

verses.ar:
Ma Ajmalaka Teri Surat Ma Ah'sanak Teri Seerat
Ma Akmalaka Teri A'zmat Teri Zaat Mein Gum Hai Khudayei
verses.en:
How beautiful is your face — how excellent is your character
How perfect is your greatness — in your being the Divine Itself is absorbed

verses.ar:
Ae Mazhar-e-shaan-e-jamali Ae Khuwaja-o-banda Aa'li
Mujhe Hashr Mein Kaam Aajaye Mera Zoq-e-sukhan Aarayei
verses.en:
O manifestation of divine beauty's glory, O master and noble servant
May my love of words serve me on the Day of Judgement

verses.ar:
Jab Jalwa Fagan Hu-aey Aaqa, Sajde Mein Jhuka Tha Kaa'bah
Aey Aminah Kaisi Teri, Qismat Hai Khuda Ne Banaai
verses.en:
When the Master appeared in his glory, even the Kaaba bowed in prostration
O Aminah — what a destiny God fashioned for you

verses.ar:
Tum Sab Se Pehle Muhaajir, Ghar Choda Khuda Ki Khaatir
Is Sunnat Par Jo Chale Hain, Aaqa Woh Hain Tere Fidaai
verses.en:
You were the first of all emigrants, you left your home for God's sake
Those who follow this Sunnah — O Master, they are your devoted ones

verses.ar:
Tu Raees-e-roz-e-shafa't Tu Ameer-e-lutf-o-i'nayat
Hai Adeeb Ko Tujhse Nisbat Ye Ghulam Hai Tu Aaqayei
verses.en:
You are the chief of the Day of Intercession, the master of grace and favour
Adeeb has connection to you — this servant is yours, you are his master
